scene.speaker: nico
scene.bubble: The elephant is big, the mouse is small, my shoes are dirty… and Mum is not happy about that!
scene.intro: Nico plays the opposites game and he never gets it right! The elephant is big, the mouse is small. This road is long, that pencil is short. His shoes are dirty, his sister's shoes are clean. My jacket is old, says Nico, and my hat is… old too! Pip looks at him: the puffin is small, but his beak is big. Big or small? Long or short? Play the game and say the opposite!

data.script: Nico: Opposites game! Big? … Astrid: Small! … Nico: Long? … Astrid: Short! Like Pip's legs. … Nico: Clean? … Astrid: Dirty! Like your shoes, Nico. … Nico: Hey! Okay… old? … Astrid: New! Like my yellow pencil. … Nico: Last one: sad? … Astrid: HAPPY! Like us, every day at break!

data.text: Point and say: find things in class that are big, small, long, new. "The board is big! Your pencil is short!" Five each.

activities.title: Spot the differences!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

homework.prompt: Find at home: something big, something small, something old, something new. Write 4 sentences.

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
Write own name; trace and copy words; label pictures (3–5 words).
